1981-2415-3845-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3430-3812-6006.easyPrerequisites: Simic Ragworm doesn't have summoning sickness.
3430-3812-6006.description:
Activate Simic Ragworm by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Simic Ragworm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1021-4693-4826-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

529-3499-5641-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

443-728-3249-4474--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
443-728-3249-4474--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Magus of the Bridge triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

728-1286-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
728-1286-5972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3899-5933.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: (one of them) exiled by Spellweaver Helix

1054-1538-1735.easyPrerequisites: You have at least one additional copy of Dragon's Approach in your library.
1054-1538-1735.description:
Cast Dragon's Approach by paying {2}{R}.
Spellweaver Helix triggers, causing you to cast a copy of Coveted Prize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Coveted Prize, causing you to search your library for a Dragon's Approach and cast it without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2 until you have cast every Dragon's Approach in your library.
Resolve a Dragon's Approach, dealing 3 damage to each opponent, and allowing you to exile it and four other cards named Dragon's Approach from your graveyard to search your library for a Dragon creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining Dragon's Approach.

5508-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Railway Brawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the persist creature.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat

1479-2841-6157-6662.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
1479-2841-6157-6662.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, Chocobo Racetrack and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1496-3490-4017-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-3490-4017-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

4499-4747-6965.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

1400-3967-4619.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1400-3967-4619.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that is black due to Darkest Hour.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2829-2866-3200-4986.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1315-2921-3234-3293.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1315-2921-3234-3293.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat
1315-2921-3234-3293.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Siren of the Silent Song

1557-3525-6723.description:
Activate Siren of the Silent Song by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Siren of the Silent Song.
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard a card and mill a card.
Repeat.

567-4017-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-4017-5641.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

539-4657-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Rofellos.
Repeat.

678-4716-5670.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana with the mana to cast it.
678-4716-5670.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1429-2034-5958.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2034-5958.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {C}{C}.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Curator Beastie.
Repeat.

427-4055-4067-5766.notablePrerequisites: Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
427-4055-4067-5766.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding {C} for each card you've drawn this turn.
If needed, activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Faerie Formation by paying {3}{U}, causing you to draw a card and create a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.
Eventually, Kydele will produce extra mana, and you may repeat steps 2 and/or 3 as mana allows.

1374-3626-4068-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1374-3626-4068-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2543-3676-3771.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
392-2543-3676-3771.description:
Cast Shivan Wurm by paying {R}{G}.
Birgi, Animar and Tangleroot trigger.
Resolve the Tangleroot and Birgi triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Shivan Wurm enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1636-1776-2026.notablePrerequisites:
Spawning Grounds attached to any Forest you control.
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
1636-1776-2026.description:
Activate the land with Spawning Grounds attached by tapping it, creating a 5/5 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping the land with Spawning Grounds attached.
Repeat.

628-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat step 1 until Devoted Druid dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Devoted Druid dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
